summary: Medicinal plants near the Statue of Unity: Ayurvedic plots, yoga spaces and calm landscaped walks on a wellness theme.
description:
Arogya Van organises a garden around the idea of health: plots of medicinal and aromatic plants arranged by therapeutic theme, water features, sculpture, indoor interpretation on Ayurveda and yoga traditions, and lawns designed for stillness rather than selfies, though the landscaping gets its share of those too.

It is one of the campus's calmer tickets, suited to the afternoon lull between the statue and the evening attractions. Plant labels reward the curious; a wellness centre section offers therapies at extra cost when operational. Treat it as a decompression hour: the point is the pace.
highlights: Medicinal and aromatic plant plots by theme
Calmest landscaped space on the campus

modes.road: On the campus circuit; e-buses stop nearby

fees.note: Adult ₹30 / child ₹20; therapies at the wellness section cost extra. Verified Aug 2026

seasonality.notes: Cool months make the outdoor plots pleasant; monsoon keeps everything vivid.

experience.photography_notes: The water features and sculpture court shoot best in late soft light.

emergency.nearest_hospital: Ekta Nagar facilities; Rajpipla civil hospital (~25 km)

tips: Use it as the between-attractions decompression hour
Plant-curious visitors should budget longer than the ticket suggests
